description: On the prestigious Avenue Foch, not far from the Arc de Triomphe and a stone's throw from Place Victor-Hugo: a luxury apartment of 290 m2 with a large private garden and a fully private spa, accessible only from the apartment. Heated indoor swimming pool, sauna, hammam and gym in the basement, with free and unlimited access. A large living room, a kitchen and 4 bedrooms, each with a private bathroom.An exceptional setting for a refined and rejuvenating stay in the heart of chic Paris.The spacePrestigious apartment completely renovated by a renowned architect, on Avenue Foch, one of the most sought-after addresses in Paris.The apartment has a superb private garden of 150 m², divided into several convivial spaces: a large outdoor dining table, garden furniture, and a relaxation area.A complete wellness area has been set up in the basement. It is entirely private, accessible only from the apartment, and reserved exclusively for its guests. It includes: - A 6 x 2.5 m heated indoor swimming pool, usable all year round- Sauna that can accommodate 6 people- Steam room that can accommodate 8 people- Fully equipped gym: weight training machine, treadmill, rowing machine, dumbbells, floor mats and accessoriesThe accommodation consists of: - 60 m² living/dining room- Fully equipped separate kitchen- Bedroom 1: 200x200 cm bed, private bathroom (shower, bathtub, toilet)- Bedroom 2: 160x200 cm bed, private bathroom (shower, toilet)- Bedroom 3: 140x200 cm bed, private bathroom (shower, toilet)- Bedroom 4: 160x200 cm bed, private bathroom (shower, toilet)Other things to noteThe accommodation is not accessible to people with reduced mobility.The wellness area (swimming pool, sauna, hammam) is entirely private and accessible only from the apartment.The swimming pool is not supervised: ca
